lmstudio-bin on Omarchy

The prebuilt-binary package of LM Studio, for running local AI models without waiting on a build.

Package data synced 2026-10-29 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install lmstudio-bin on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add lmstudio-bin. It is a 1 GB download (1 GB installed), version 0.4.27-2, licensed EULA. LM Studio - A desktop app for exploring and running large language models locally. Free to use (free for personal and commercial use, no premium tiers).

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install lmstudio-bin on Omarchy

This is the same LM Studio desktop app as the source-build package, just distributed as a ready-to-run binary instead of being compiled from source at install time. It lets you discover, download, and chat with open-source language models locally through a ChatGPT-style interface, keeping all inference on your own hardware.

Watch: Getting started with LM Studio (100% private local AI) ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add lmstudio-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.4.27-2:
    pacman -Qi lmstudio-bin

Open and use lmstudio-bin

lmstudio-bin is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql lmstudio-bin | grep applications

lmstudio-bin requirements and compatibility

  • Enough disk space and RAM/VRAM to hold whichever local model you download
  • A capable GPU (or Apple Silicon) speeds up inference but is not strictly required
  • Network access only when browsing or downloading models from Hugging Face; runs fully offline afterward

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • fuse2
  • zlib
  • hicolor-icon-theme
  • gtk3
  • nss
  • libxcrypt-compat

Pricing and license

Free to use (free for personal and commercial use, no premium tiers). License: EULA.

Uninstall lmstudio-bin

omarchy pkg drop lmstudio-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install lmstudio-bin on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add lmstudio-bin. The download is 1 GB and it takes 1 GB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is lmstudio-bin free?

Free to use (free for personal and commercial use, no premium tiers). The package is licensed EULA.

How do I uninstall lmstudio-bin?

Run omarchy pkg drop lmstudio-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does lmstudio-bin depend on?

The package declares 6 dependencies: fuse2, zlib, hicolor-icon-theme, gtk3, nss, libxcrypt-compat. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is lmstudio-bin a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for lmstudio-bin.

Is lmstudio-bin in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as lmstudio-bin (version 0.4.27-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. LM Studio makes it. Project site: https://lmstudio.ai.
